summary.text: Bernie Moreno is a U.S. Senator from Ohio, serving on the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs, Banking, Commerce, and Budget Committees.

paragraphs.text: Before the Senate he worked in the auto industry, beginning at General Motors, and in 2005 bought a car dealership near Cleveland that became the Collection Auto Group.
He also co-founded the blockchain vehicle-title company CHAMP Titles and later launched Ownum, and lives in Ohio with his wife, Bridget.
